note: Local metres around each anchor: +x east, +z south (three.js local axes before rotation). buildings = the app's own records (site/nycdata, what it draws and hides under a landmark hull): h / base = the app heights (m; from the New York City building import where mapped, else estimated), osm = the OSM way / relation the footprint came from (match = IoU), h_osm / levels = the OSM tags, parts = the app's building:part tiers (base / top) with their OSM part id. roads: cls as in the app, elev = the app's deck height above the ground per vertex (bridges kept whole when inside the box). areas: OSM land-use polygons clipped to the box. pois: named OSM nodes. ground = terrain height at the anchor. radius = max(1.6 r, r + 60), capped at 700 m. Heights of towers in the data are often wrong: use the verified h of the target.
